description: This source file, written in C#, provides extension methods for the ISiloBuilder interface to configure Azure Table transactional state storage in an Orleans silo. It includes methods to set default storage and named storage with optional configuration parameters.

classes.name: AzureTableTransactionSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for ISiloBuilder to configure Azure Table transactional storage.

methods.name: AddAzureTableTransactionalStateStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Configures the silo to use Azure Table storage as the default transactional grain storage.

methods.name: AddAzureTableTransactionalStateStorage
methods.description: Configures the silo to use Azure Table storage with a specified name and optional configuration.

methods.name: AddAzureTableTransactionalStateStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Overload that configures the silo with optional options builder to use default Azure Table storage.

methods.name: AddAzureTableTransactionalStateStorage
methods.description: Overload that configures the silo with optional options builder for a named Azure Table storage.
